name: Mövenpick Hotel Mactan Island Cebu
short_description: A 245-room Mediterranean-styled 5-star beachfront resort in Punta Engaño, Mactan Island, roughly 6km from Mactan-Cebu International Airport.
ai_summary: Mövenpick Hotel Mactan Island Cebu is a 245-room beachfront resort in Punta Engaño on Mactan Island, styled around a Mediterranean and Ibiza-inspired aesthetic with an all-white, Greek-influenced courtyard, roughly 6km (about a 15-20 minute drive) from Mactan-Cebu International Airport. The resort sits on a private white-sand beach and offers 14 room categories from 33-square-metre Deluxe rooms up to the 224-square-metre Ibiza Loft penthouse, alongside four restaurants including all-day buffet venue The Sails and beach club Ibiza. Guests repeatedly praise the private beach, attentive staff, and Mövenpick's signature Chocolate Hour, while reviews flag that entry-level Deluxe rooms feel basic relative to the resort's higher categories and that poolside drinks run pricey.

faqs.question: Does Mövenpick Hotel Mactan Island Cebu have a private beach?
faqs.answer: Yes -- the resort sits directly on a private white-sand beach in Punta Engaño on Mactan Island, which guest reviews describe as clean and well maintained, with clear water. It's one of the resort's most consistently praised features alongside the pool and staff service.

faqs.question: How far is Mövenpick Hotel Mactan Island Cebu from Mactan-Cebu International Airport?
faqs.answer: Roughly 6km, about a 15-20 minute drive depending on traffic, making it one of the more airport-convenient beachfront resorts on Mactan Island. Cebu City's malls, casinos and golf courses are described by Accor as no more than about 22km away.
